verdict.rationale: Supabase provides auto-generated REST/GraphQL APIs, TypeScript type generation, and quickstart docs for connecting projects, which support building against official client libraries, and its CLI/MCP tooling make it usable by AI agents. However, the evidence pack never explicitly documents a suite of official SDKs (e.g., JS, Python, Flutter) or their API surfaces beyond generated types. Missing for 10: explicit official SDK/client-library documentation across languages, code samples showing SDK usage, and independent confirmation that AI agents build reliably against these SDKs.
